race.comment: STORMBRINGER (11) is edging his way towards an overdue win, and he hit the line strongly for second over 1400m at Nowra 2 weeks ago. He is having his first run over 1600m this prep, and can go one better. BELLEISTIC KIDS (1) peaked on his second up run at Hawkesbury 10 days ago, and should be spot on for this easier assignment. A 2kg claim will help offset his weight rise, an he looks to be perfectly placed to break his win drought in this. MATHRIN (7) is another veteran mare, and she is resuming from a spell without any public trials. Use the market as your best guide. SHADOW DANE (6) will find this easier than his last couple of runs, and dropping back to 1600m will also be in his favour. A good draw, and a 1.5kg claim, gives him a good chance to bounce back into the top 3. TALKACHINO (12) won the Grenfell Cup 8-days ago, and he can measure up in this as well.
